name: zc_sun_caster

tests.name: the two-caster defect reproduces at 23:00 on this build

detail.note: the world lane measured this from the actor list. Reproduced here before anything is changed, because a fix for a defect that is not present is a change with no reason.

tests.name: the approved night reads as the world lane measured it

detail.note: THE GATE'S OWN CALIBRATION. If this vantage does not reproduce their number then the gate below is measuring something else and no verdict from it means anything.

tests.name: the sun's light component was found
a knob exists that stops the sun casting AND leaves the approved night where it is

detail.note: BOTH OR IT IS NOT A FIX. Dropping the caster count while lifting the night is the change the founder forbade -- the first attempt at this took dusk from 0.103 to 0.191 and lifted the whole night by half. Holding the night while still casting twice leaves the defect.

tests.name: every knob was put back and the night is casting as it was
